_doc: PLACEHOLDER-draft — Sérgio voice pass pending on every string below. Session 70. FLOPPYSHEEP is HIS name and his ask ('just feel like the need to the FloppySheep to be there would be good'). It is the mascot game on Vera's phone: one thumb, tap to hop. ⚑ WHY IT BELONGS, and why it had to be BUILT rather than written down: it is one tap away WHILE A COMMENT SITS UNANSWERED, which is what everybody does at work. The piece says NOTHING about that — no scolding, no timer, no guilt, no ledger entry, ever. And it is the same publisher's lamb (`publisher` below): the brand still ships delight while its serious arm has become a workflow. THAT is the joke, and it is on the apparatus.
_docRegister: ⚑ IT IS NOT RESPITE. E3 has no respite — Sérgio's decision, confirmed, and this does not quietly reintroduce one. FloppySheep is `operable`: the apparatus's own cheerful product, made by the same people who made the correction list. Do not treat it as a shelter, do not let it become a reward, and do not gate anything on it. It must also be GENUINELY FUN — a game that is deliberately bad would be the piece sneering at her for playing it, and Vera is never the joke.
_docScore: The counts (CALLED, WITH YOU, the end card's numbers, the OUTREACH ×N) are the GAME's own, shown inside the game's own frame, in the game's own cheerful voice — that is what a 2016 casual game does. Nothing is carried out of it: no best score, no streak kept across runs, no session record, nothing filed to the ledger, and no number the piece ever refers to. A best-score line would make it a reward, which is the one thing it must never become. The clock in its header is the SONG's (the level lasts as long as his song); nothing outside the game times her.
_docV7: ⚑ S221 (2026-10-08) — FloppySheep v7 replaces the S70 fence-hopper, ported from the games review's prototype (Pc_Simulation/Games_Proposals_2026-10-07_v7/floppysheep_v7.html), which Sérgio approved: 'amazing and that's it'. The line of his notes it answers: v4→v5 'much better production'; v5→v6 'I would add more stuff, to make it more over the top'; v6→v7 'v6 is really fun and good! ... the confetti cannons are a bit too much at the start as they repeat a lot, but it was a great addition' (so v7 re-paces the cannons and changes nothing else). THE GAME: the level is HIS SONG — the world scrolls by the song's clock, and every line he wrote is answered by something in the level, timed to reach the sheep as it is sung and lit gold while it is (src/desktop/apps/floppysheepCourse.ts). She calls lambs by touching them; they follow; they drift away, more and more as the song goes on — people choosing, never an enemy, never mocked. The programme's pressures (megaphone drones, the recruiter's crook, quota inspectors) cost a lamb, never a life; there is no game over before the song ends. Over it lies the PLATFORM's bombast (balloon, choir, cannons and rockets, the revival tent, the Jumbotron, OUTREACH combos) which collapses on its own at the end: the fuel runs out. The spectacle button calms it (no shake, no flash) and is the default under reduced motion. ADAPTED FOR THE HOST, and only that: the piece's one mute (no own sound switch), tap only (no keys, no hold: every hop is the full hop, so 'hold to go higher' left the how-to), a Back arrow in the header, the calm switch drawn inside the screen. The two old clips (click/fail_floppysheep.mp3) are no longer played by it.
title: FloppySheep
_docSections: The nine chapters of the song, in order (their numbers are in floppysheepCourse.ts SECTIONS). Each name is toasted as its chapter begins.
_docCourse: Words that are part of the level itself: the warning sign the meadow opens under ('Error state'), and the five keycaps she hops across on 'my fingers shake on the input keys' (one letter a key, in order).
_docPush: The footer's cheer while she runs, one every 14 s: the platform's voice, never the piece's.
push: Don't let a single one slip away!
_docTiers: MEGA OUTREACH: lambs called in a row, at 3 / 6 / 10 / 15 / 22. A bump ends the streak; a lamb drifting away never does — the programme counts only what it called.
_docBoard: The Jumbotron's lamps: the 3×5 type of the 2003 phone, upper case, letters/digits/! * - ' and space only.

intro.title: FloppySheep!
intro.voice: Hello, shepherd! The meadow is full of little lambs who haven't heard the good news yet. Call every one you meet, and keep them close until the song is over. Don't let a single one slip away!
intro.how: Tap or click to hop (tap again in the air to keep rising). Touch a lamb to call it. Call them in a row for OUTREACH!
intro.length: the level lasts as long as the song · {t}

outro.title: LEVEL COMPLETE!!!
outro.said: Lamby says: what a day! You called
outro.after: lambs. Let's call even more tomorrow!
